subject: Rebalancing executive window for product showcase — CTO travel delay + VP add
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie@everlane.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: adjust timing for Thursday product showcase

Hi Olga —

Quick update from our side: our CTO's flight into SF was pushed back and he now arrives late Thursday evening. The VP of Engineering (who's been asking to join) has availability only in a narrow window earlier that day or the following morning. We still want your team's walkthrough — it's important for final alignment — but the executive mix changed last minute.

Can we do one of the following so both execs can attend (or at least be covered):
- Option A: Move the demo earlier on Thu (09/21) to 10:00–10:45 PT (VP can join live; CTO joins remotely later)
- Option B: Keep Thu slot and follow with a 30-min CTO Q&A on Fri morning (09/22) at 08:30 PT
- Option C: Shift to Fri 09/22 09:00–09:45 PT so both can attend live (preferred if you can accommodate)

We're trying to avoid dropping execs from the session. Rafael from your SE team suggested a compact agenda if we need to compress. I've attached a short note on what we'd prioritize if time is limited.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lang
Senior Eng Partner, Everlane
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie@everlane.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: adjust timing for Thursday product showcase

Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the options. Sorry to hear about the flight disruption. I'm looping Rafael (SE) and Vivek (product lead) so we can confirm availability and make a clean call. A few quick notes from our side:

- We can compress the walkthrough to ~35 minutes and preserve a 10–15 minute CTO-focused Q&A that Rafael will lead. That fits Option A with minor edits to slides.
- Option B (Thu + short Fri QA) works technically but introduces handoff friction — we'd prefer a single contiguous session if the CTO can join at any point.
- Option C (moving to Fri) is acceptable if you confirm by EOD — we have some capacity but need to avoid conflicts with other demos.

Proposed next step: choose A/C now if you have a preference and we'll send an updated calendar invite + new agenda (attached). I've included proposed_slots.ics with the three candidate times. If you pick Option A, Rafael will prep a short CTO Q&A appendix.

Quick ask for your team: if the VP has any specific topics (cost/latency, dedicated vs hosted, private deployment concerns), call them out so Rafael can bring supporting metrics.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0173
From: Sophie Lang <sophie@everlane.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Everlane SE Team <se-team@everlane.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: adjust timing for Thursday product showcase

Olga — we talked quickly on the VP side. They prefer Option A (move earlier Thursday to 10:00 PT) so the VP can be present live. CTO will try to dial in remotely but may only be available for the Q&A at the end.

Two small asks:
1) Can you compress the core demo to 35 minutes so we have 10–15 minutes reserved for CTO Q&A? (Yes to Rafael leading that.)
2) Could you include a 2-slide summary on pricing convexity and tail-latency impact (VP cares about economics + reliability)?

If you can send the updated agenda and calendar invite, we will confirm with the CTO's assistant.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sophie
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie@everlane.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 2026-09-21 10:00–10:45 PT — compressed demo + CTO Q&A

Sophie / Everlane team — confirmed. We moved the session to Thursday 2026-09-21 10:00–10:45 PT (updated invite attached). Summary of what changed vs original:

- Core demo compressed to 35 minutes (high-level walkthrough, 3 prioritized use-cases)
- 10–15 minute live CTO Q&A at the end; Rafael will handle architecture & latency questions
- Added 2-slide appendix on pricing vs throughput and tail-latency mitigation (per VP request)

Attachments included: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (finalized for the compressed window), proposed_slots.ics (original options). HubSpot deal and calendar invite links below.

Action items:
- Rafael: please load the latency appendix into the deck and flag any tradeoffs to call out (done).
- Sophie: will confirm CTO dial-in availability with assistant; if CTO can only make the Q&A, we'll record the session and share the clip.
- Vivek: I'll run a 5-minute run-through with Rafael at 08:45 PT Thu morning to ensure segues are tight.

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/redwood-evr-demo-0921
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/EVR-2026-094

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
